name: v-menu
description: V-Menu: QR-code restaurant ordering as three microservices and a Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,restaurant,menu,order,web -c gray,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "npm:dev:db" "npm --prefix backend/services/restaurant run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/menu run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/order run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n restaurant,menu,order -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend/services/restaurant run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/menu run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/order run dev"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deps && npm test
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm run test:repo
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix e2e run typecheck
scripts.seed: npm --prefix backend/services/restaurant run seed && npm --prefix backend/services/menu run seed
scripts.docker:up: GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo local) docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml up --build -d
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml exec -T restaurant-service node dist/seed.js && docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml exec -T menu-service node dist/seed.js
